column2: [intro]
When I step into a darkened room,
I feel the thrill, it’s my escape from gloom,
The projectors light up my heart,
I’m ready for a brand-new start.
In my life, it’s like a film reel,
I’m hooked, I’m a true film zeal,
From emotions to laughter 'til dawn’s first light,
It’s my passion, the seventh art feels just right.
From superheroes to eternal love,
Scenarios that make me rise above,
I feel like a star in Hollywood’s gleam,
Cinema is my ultimate dream.
I drift away in this magic land,
With characters and stories so grand,
From comedies to epic dramas’ might,
Cinema fills me with pure delight.
[ solo ]
In my life, it’s like a film reel,
I’m hooked, I’m a true film zeal,
From emotions to laughter 'til dawn’s first light,
It’s my passion, the seventh art feels just right.
[outro]
